name.full: SAS Viya Analyst for Microsoft 365 Copilot

description.short: Explore SAS Viya data and run SAS analytics from Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full: A declarative agent that connects Microsoft 365 Copilot to a SAS Viya environment through the SAS Viya MCP Server. Discover CAS tables, profile columns, query data with FedSQL, and execute SAS code — all from a Copilot conversation, with each user authenticated against Viya as themselves.
